_readme: OSHIVA (OLS Hybrid Intelligence Virtual Assistant) - non-secret config. Copy to 'assistant.json'
(same folder; git-ignored). The model API key is a SECRET and goes in .env as ASSISTANT_API_KEY.
ACCESS CONTROL (the two fields you care about):
enabled        : the MASTER on/off switch for the whole bot.
false = OSHIVA is OFF for EVERYONE (even B27886).
true  = OSHIVA is ON, but only for the usernames in allowed_users.
allowed_users  : the hard-coded allow-list of usernames who may see/use OSHIVA.
["B27886"] = only the owner.
["*"]      = EVERYONE (public). <-- change to this to REMOVE the hard-coding
and open the bot to all users (still subject to `enabled`).
NOTE on SSO: the username checked is the AUTHENTICATED caller. With SSO ON that is the real person,
so ["B27886"] truly limits OSHIVA to B27886. With SSO OFF the app shares one dummy login, so it
cannot tell developers apart - there, `enabled` (and this file being per-machine) is the real gate.
OTHER SETTINGS:
use_stub       : true = built-in scaffold brain (no model). false = call the real GPT-OSS endpoint.
use_mock_tools : true = tools return mock data. false = real backend services.
model/base_url/timeout : REAL GPT-OSS config (used when use_stub=false). base_url is an OpenAI-compatible
base (POST {base}/v1/chat/completions); model is the served id; timeout is seconds.
The API KEY is the ONLY GPT-OSS secret and does NOT belong here — put it in .env as
ASSISTANT_API_KEY. (Each may also be set via .env: ASSISTANT_MODEL/_BASE_URL/_TIMEOUT/_USE_STUB.)
max_steps      : max tool-calling iterations per question.
temperature    : model sampling temperature.
session_ttl_hours : idle conversation memory auto-purged after this many hours (default 72).
rate_limit_per_min : max chat turns per caller per minute (0 disables). Edge protection for the LLM.
cost_per_1k_input / cost_per_1k_output : money cost per 1,000 tokens for the usage report. Self-hosted
GPT-OSS has no bill so both default to 0 (you still get token counts + latency); set them
to model a chargeback or a third-party comparison. cost_currency is a display label only.
TOOL AUTHORIZATION (which business lines a caller may query - group/cib/retail):
REAL mode uses the caller's RBAC. DEV/DUMMY mode uses these two:
dummy_default_scopes : fallback scopes for any caller (["*"] = all).
dummy_scope_grants   : {username: ["retail","group"]} to give a dev user limited scopes
(handy to see a real 'you don't have access to CIB' denial in dev).
